## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-enhancements`, `area:global_attention`, `mod-frost`.

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary

`DENSE_SERVING_CCS` held cc 10.7 and cc 10.0. Its comment declined cc 10.3 by name: "cc 10.3 (B300) runs the same SM100 kernels but is unproven through the block: DECLINED BY NAME until its cells run". Those cells have now run on a B300, so the tuple gains `(10, 3)`.

On cc 10.3 the block now serves the dense prefill, EXTEND and DECODE inference forms through the same SM100 d256 kernels. The cc 10.0 declines still apply there:

- `fuse_gate`
- the fused projection forks
- the quantized pipelines other than the FP8-projection mode below
- `save_for_backward`
- `thd=True` over the block's own K / V
- a QsaSpec geometry
- the 32-column decode arm

`FP8_PROJ_BF16_ATTENTION_CCS` gains `(10, 3)` as well (second commit): the FP8 forced-tile GEMM cell at the mode's shapes, which admits a part into that tuple, and the mode's DECODE / EXTEND cells ran on the B300. The launch-census table gains its cc 10.3 row (8 / 7, the cc 10.0 counts, measured by the census there). `decode_route(device_cc=(10, 3))` reads the SM100 line's rule, the same cells as cc 10.0 with `device_cc` (10, 3). This follows from the existing `cc != (10, 7)` line test, so no routing code changed.

Text changes:

- `api.py`: the module docstring, the `DENSE_SERVING_CCS` comment, the `decode_route` docstring, and the dense part statement ("cc 10.0 / 10.3 (SM100 / SM103: ...)"; the cc 10.3 suffix is gone).
- `SUPPORT_MATRIX_TRACKER.md`: an "Admitted 2026-10-31" paragraph with the run record (Rule S2), the cc 10.3 run record of the FP8-projection mode, the gaps row, and the sentences that called cc 10.3 declined / unserved.

The tests pinned the device to cc 10.0 in several places. On a B300 with only the tuple changed, 61 cases failed on these pins before reaching any oracle compare. They now read the device's own part:

- `_sm100_pin`: the compiled route's `device_cc == _cc()`.
- The decline texts on the part: `cc {major}.{minor}` and `this device is SM{major}{minor}`.
- The FP8-mode branch: `_cc() in FP8_PROJ_BF16_ATTENTION_CCS`.
- The extend envelope's `device_cc`.
- `_sm100_pin_extend` on the packed-KV EXTEND case also pins on cc 10.3.

The host rows change too:

- `test_the_sm100_route_table_is_the_adapters_rule` asserts that `decode_route(device_cc=(10, 3))` equals the cc 10.0 cell with `device_cc` (10, 3). Only sm80 is left as the unserved probe.
- `test_the_envelope_declines_every_other_part_without_raising` drops its `sm103` case.
- The conftest marker texts name both parts.

## Why

The block declined a part that runs its kernels. The constant's own comment named the missing step: running the cc 10.3 cells through the block.

## Related issues

None found.

## API and compatibility impact

`DENSE_SERVING_CCS` and `FP8_PROJ_BF16_ATTENTION_CCS` (public in `cudnn.gated_attention_block`) gain `(10, 3)`. A serving stack that reads it as its dispatch predicate now dispatches the dense bf16 / f16 forms to the block on cc 10.3. cc 10.0 and cc 10.7 behave as before. The only change there is the wording of the dense part statement that unserved parts see.

## Testing

B300 (cc 10.3), develop `64ed3dfe` with its own extension, torch 2.14.1+cu130, cuDNN 9.27.0, CuTe DSL 4.8.1, `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`, one GPU, `python -m pytest gated_attention_block/cutedsl` from `test/python`:

| Module | develop | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `test_block_serving_decode.py` | 74 passed, 159 skipped | 116 passed, 116 skipped |
| `test_block_serving_extend.py` | 52 passed, 13 skipped | 58 passed, 7 skipped |
| `test_block_serving_mtp_route.py` | 20 passed, 24 skipped | 24 passed, 20 skipped |
| `test_block_serving_capture.py` | 8 passed, 15 skipped | 23 passed |
| `test_block_serving_pdl.py` | 3 passed, 19 skipped | 6 passed, 16 skipped |
| `test_block_end_to_end.py` | 19 passed, 42 skipped | 41 passed, 20 skipped |
| `test_block_fp8_bf16_attention.py` | 10 passed, 6 skipped | 16 passed |
| `test_block_thd.py` | 19 passed, 41 skipped | 20 passed, 40 skipped |
| `test_sdpa_stage_sm107.py` | 6 passed, 11 skipped | 5 passed, 12 skipped |
| **whole directory** | **2466 passed, 1623 skipped** | **2564 passed, 0 failed, 1524 skipped** |

- The newly running cases include the oracle cells: decode at every group and S_q, the 27B geometry, the L1/L2/L3 pools bitwise, the MTP prefill route, the packed K|V cache rows and capture.
- `test_sdpa_stage_sm107.py` gains one skip: the decline-on-an-unserved-part row now skips on cc 10.3. `test_block_serving_decode.py` has one case fewer, the removed `sm103` probe.
- The 1524 skips with this PR:
  - 1463 are Rubin-only rows (SM107-only tests, `sm_107a` / SM 10.7 features);
  - 40 are the FP8-projection mode's decline;
  - 19 are environment skips (no `nvdisasm` / `cuobjdump` on PATH, one visible GPU, an optional transformers check);
  - 2 are rows that cannot fire on a served part.
- The whole directory ran once with this change. `test_block_serving_decode.py`, `test_block_serving_extend.py` and `test_block_end_to_end.py` then had three more cc 10.0 pins corrected (the FP8-mode branch and two decline texts) and ran again: 215 passed, 0 failed, 143 skipped. The product code did not change between the two runs. The table counts those three modules from the second run.
- FP8-projection mode (second commit), same part: `test_block_fp8_bf16_attention.py` 16 passed (the FP8 forced-tile GEMM cell included); with the tuple holding cc 10.3, `test_block_serving_decode.py` 151 passed / 1 failed / 80 skipped and `test_block_serving_extend.py` 62 passed / 3 skipped. The failure was the launch census, whose per-part table had no cc 10.3 row; with the row it passed (with the mode's module: 17 passed).
- Not run on cc 10.0 or cc 10.7. The test edits read the device's own part, so they assert the same values there.
- Functional only. No performance was measured on cc 10.3.

That outer hit bypasses compiled_cache's device-aware memoization. A host probe of the real loader and decode compile function confirmed that changing the modeled part from 10.0 to 10.3 returned the same first-target artifact without reaching the compiler; clearing the outer cache reached the second target.
